## How the bits of a token are written

`encoding` has four strings of 6 octal digits: `w4` (bits 63-48), `w3` (47-32), `w2` (31-16) and `w1` (15-0). A token sets the bits that are 1 in its groups; the tokens of one instruction are ORed together.
